title: GQL as the only query language
statement: The system shall accept GQL (ISO/IEC 39075:2024) as its only query and data-manipulation language for nodes and edges.
rationale: PO decision: GQL replaces PartiQL; the data is an entity-relationship graph.

acceptance_criteria.text: A published conformance matrix lists every GQL feature as supported, partially supported or unsupported.
All statements marked supported in the conformance matrix pass the project's GQL conformance test suite.
Unsupported GQL syntax returns a parse error naming the unsupported feature.
